item.title: Box Enterprise
item.description: Box Enterprise stands as the most sophisticated content management platform for global organizations that cannot compromise on security, compliance, or governance when handling sensitive business information. Trusted by over 100,000 organizations including 67% of the Fortune 500, including GE, AstraZeneca, and Morgan Stanley, Box Enterprise has revolutionized how regulated industries manage critical content while enabling seamless collaboration across global teams. This enterprise-grade platform emerged to solve the fundamental challenge facing large organizations: how to maintain productivity and collaboration while meeting stringent regulatory requirements like HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR that traditional file sharing solutions simply cannot address.
